source_policy: Only OPM and federal .gov sources are used. Payroll and grade/senior-plan counts are public OPM Federal Workforce Data rows; redacted public rows are not reassigned to any locality.

snapshot.count_field_note: The OPM count field is 1 on every row in this employment release, so row count equals visible employee count for these aggregates.

definitions.cost_metric: Sum of numeric annualized_adjusted_basic_pay for visible OPM rows in the locality pay area. Redacted pay rows are excluded from dollar totals.
definitions.high_gs_definition: GS pay_plan_code rows with numeric grades 13, 14, or 15.
definitions.ses_definition: SES is pay_plan_code ES. A separate senior_pay_plan_count also includes ES, SL, and ST rows.
definitions.share_denominator: Percentages use all visible OPM rows in the locality area, including rows whose pay amount is redacted.
definitions.rus_relocation_scenario: Scenario estimate only: for visible OPM annualized adjusted basic pay in 2026 locality areas above Rest of U.S., divide by the current locality factor and reapply the 2026 Rest of U.S. locality factor. It does not decide telework eligibility, mission need, special rates, pay caps, bargaining, real estate, travel, or hiring costs.
